# Launch roster and candidate classification v1

Production identity/specification only; runtime oracle IDs, stats, cards and replay format remain unchanged.

Current owner task explicitly delegates selection of 16 launch + 4 reserve; this supersedes the earlier plan requesting a separate roster-selection approval. Source-unsupported visual details remain proposal; rights clearance is not delegated or inferred.

Authored source: `hero_roster.json`. All eight original fields remain at each source pointer. Names, species, title, role, personality and weapon style are sourced; gender/presentation is unresolved for all 20. All body, motion, material, rig and height details under `design_proposal` are explicitly proposals. Branch aliases are normalized exactly once.

## 4 reserve heroes

| ID | Name | Branches | Why reserve |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| gruttar_tuskgold | Gruttar Tuskgold | Assault; Shield | Hammer/charge heavy overlaps Karchar and Rhazgor. Assault and Shield remain covered three times; preserve as future disruptor. |
| nyxara_nightstep | Nyxara Nightstep | Dodge; Wound | Bleed assassin overlaps Sylvex/Morvayne while evasive duelist is held by Kitsara/Lupika. Keeping Skarvex instead preserves a second Toxin entry and adds chitin morphology. |
| zelkara_jadeclaw | Zelkara Jadeclaw | Precision; Dodge | Exact unordered branch pair duplicates Kitsara; blade-arm retargeting and human-to-insect image conflict raise first-wave risk. Preserve for dedicated counter-duelist expansion. |
| kongaru_ironpalm | Kongaru Ironpalm | Power; Guardian | Heavy protective palm fighter overlaps Brumgar sustain, Solkael counter guard and Rajuro palms. Guardian/Power remain covered three times; preserve long-arm retarget extension for later. |
